descriptionChirho: Wild-growing grass or green herbage of the field, often used in imagery of transience and divine provision (Arabic عُشْب, Hindi घास, Swahili majani/nyasi).
Cultivated or edible plants, vegetation, and herbs, especially as food granted by God to humans and animals (Arabic نَبَات, Hindi पौधा/जड़ी-बूटियाँ, Swahili mimea).
